_meta.description: Complete asset inventory across all packs. Grouped by pack name to track style mixing.

Cube World - Aug 2023.notes: Self-contained glTF (embedded buffers/textures). Characters/enemies/animals have skeletal animations.

Pirate Kit - Nov 2023.notes: Characters have 14 animations (Idle, Walk, Run, Jump, Attack, Death, etc). Includes ships, weapons, cliffs, palm trees, UI props.

Sushi Restaurant Kit - May 2023.notes: Characters (panda/rabbits) have ~25 animations. Large set of environment, food, and decoration props.

Toon Shooter Game Kit - Dec 2022.notes: Characters have 17 animations. Urban decay environment, guns, barriers, debris.

Ultimate Animated Character Pack - Nov 2.notes: 52 characters all animated (16 clips each). Huge variety: soldiers, ninjas, pirates, cowboys, chefs, doctors, zombies, etc.

Ultimate Monsters.notes: 50 monsters across 3 size classes (Big, Blob, Flying). Mix-and-match style. All animated with 8-14 clips each.

Ultimate Space Kit - March 2023.notes: Space characters, vehicles, planets, alien flora. Characters have ~15 animations.

Simple Alphabet.notes: Single GLB containing separate A-Z letter meshes and 0-9 number meshes for typing and combo feedback.

Animated Fish Pack by @Quaternius.notes: 7 fish models. FBX only — no glTF. Needs conversion or FBXLoader to use in Three.js.

Cute Fish Pack - Feb 2020.notes: 52 static fish models. FBX only — no glTF.

Ultimate Food Pack - Oct 2019.notes: 103 static food models. FBX only — no glTF.

Ultimate House Interior Pack - June 2020.notes: 123 static interior models. FBX only — no glTF.
